errors.text_span: Стойностите на оста X са разположени на интервали от една година и включват 2010, 2011, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2025 и 2030.
errors.evidence: The intervals on the x-axis are not one year, but vary (e.g., 2 years between 2010 and 2012, 4 years between 2021 and 2025). Additionally, the year 2011 is not a labeled tick mark on the axis.

errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена като “Цена за USD/kWh”
errors.evidence: The y-axis label is 'USD'. 'Цена за USD/kWh' is the label for the data series in the legend, not the axis label.

errors.text_span: Стойностите на оста Y са разположени на интервали от 100 USD и включват 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900, 1000, 1100, 1200, 1300 и 1400 USD.
errors.evidence: The y-axis tick marks are at intervals of 200 USD, not 100 USD. The description hallucinates tick marks that are not present (e.g., 100, 300, 500).

errors.text_span: Линията започва около 1400 USD в 2010 г.
errors.evidence: The line starts at approximately 1200 USD in 2010. 1400 USD is the maximum value of the y-axis, not the starting point of the line.

errors.text_span: и пада до приблизително 100 USD в 2018 г.
errors.evidence: In 2018, the value is approximately 180 USD, not 100 USD. The price drops to around 100 USD much later, around 2025.

errors.text_span: След 2018 г. линията се стабилизира и цената остава в диапазона от 150 USD до 200 USD до 2025 г.
errors.evidence: The line does not stabilize in this range. It continues to decrease steadily after 2018, falling below 150 USD shortly after and reaching approximately 90 USD by 2025.

errors.text_span: след което леко се покачва до приблизително 180 USD в 2030 г.
errors.evidence: The line does not rise; it continues its downward trend to its lowest point in 2030, at approximately 70 USD. The description incorrectly states both the trend (rising instead of falling) and the value (180 USD instead of ~70 USD).
